cases.name: Bloodline Shaman
cases.text: {T}: Choose a creature type. Reveal the top card of your library. If that card is an artifact card of the chosen type, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it into your graveyard.

cases.name: Candles of Leng
cases.text: {3}, {T}: Reveal the top card of your library. If it has the same name as a card in your graveyard, put it into your graveyard. Otherwise, draw a card.

cases.name: Countryside Crusher
cases.text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, put it into your graveyard and repeat this process.
Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cases.name: Enduring Renewal
cases.text:
Play with your hand revealed.
If you would draw a card, reveal the top card of your library instead. If it's a land card, put it into your graveyard. Otherwise, draw a card.
Whenever a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, return it to your hand.

cases.name: Gathering Stone
cases.text:
As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
Spells you cast of the chosen type cost {2} less to cast.
When this artifact enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. If it's a card of the chosen type, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
